operation.description: Egress streams egress requests and responses. Logically, this is not actually a streaming request, but uses streaming as a mechanism to flip the client-server relationship of gRPC so that the server can act as a client. The listener, the RPC server, accepts connections from the dialer, the RPC client. The listener streams http requests and the dialer streams http responses.
